name: gitpulse
description: GitPulse AI - GitHub engineering analytics platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,web -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run server" "npm run worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n server,web -c green,magenta "npm run server" "npm run dev:web"
